newsitem.title: USA: Sylvan to proceed with Nat'l Education deal.
newsitem.headline: Sylvan to proceed with Nat'l Education deal.

text.p: Sylvan Learning Systems Inc said it is proceeding with its planned acquisition of National Education Corp, despite a rival bid from Harcourt General Inc.

"The benefits of combining Sylvan and NEC have been evidenced to us for some time and the offer by Harcourt General validates our view of the inherent value of NEC. We continue to view the combination of Sylvan and NEC as the best way to create value for the shareholders of both companies and we are proceeding as planned to finalize the transaction," said Sylvan president Doug Becker in a statement.
